name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Reactive Plate Carrier Mk. VII
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Reactive Plate Carrier Mk. VII
description: A modular plate carrier incorporating reactive armor elements that detonate outward on ballistic impact, disrupting incoming projectiles before they reach the wearer. Each reactive cell is a micro-explosive sandwich that detonates directionally upon detecting high-velocity impact, defeating armor-piercing rounds that would penetrate conventional plates. The carrier holds 24 reactive cells arranged in overlapping coverage zones, and spent cells can be replaced in the field from standard cartridge packs. The detonation is localized enough that adjacent cells remain functional, though operators report the experience of being 'saved' by a reactive cell as violently unpleasant — you survive, but you feel the explosion.

specifications.info: individually replaceable; rear; and side torso; 4-cell cartridge packs
specifications.operator effect: Significant concussive sensation on cell activation

story_hooks: A batch of reactive cells has been manufactured with reversed detonation direction — they explode inward instead of outward, turning a life-saving vest into a suicide device on the first hit.

An operator survived six reactive cell detonations in a single engagement — the cumulative concussive force has caused internal injuries, and the question of whether reactive armor is safe for the wearer is now in court.

physical_description.visual_profile: A tactical plate carrier with a distinctly industrial aesthetic—angular and geometrically organized. The front torso displays a 4×6 grid of raised, hexagonal reactive cell housings arranged in overlapping diamond patterns. Each cell is a distinct raised module with a slightly beveled face, creating a 3D quilted appearance. The overall silhouette is utilitarian and imposing, designed for maximum impact absorption visibility.
physical_description.dimensions: Standard adult torso fit; approximately 56cm wide across the shoulders, 60cm length front-to-back including side panels. Cell modules protrude roughly 2.5cm from the carrier surface.
physical_description.weight_description: 9.8 kg fully loaded—significant enough to require proper load distribution. Designed to be worn with support harness; not pocketable or handheld.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic-grade synthetic polymer matrix housing with embedded reactive cell cartridges; reinforced nylon webbing and load-bearing straps
physical_description.finish: Matte industrial gray with anodized black accent rigging. Reactive cell faces have a subtle oil-slick iridescence—evidence of energetic compound layering beneath transparent polymer caps.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary; matte black webbing and adjustment hardware; faint rainbow sheen visible on cell faces under direct light, hinting at volatile chemistry within
physical_description.interface_elements: Quick-release magnetic cartridge ports along both lower sides (marked with white tactile indicators); adjustment straps with mil-spec ladder-loc buckles; small LCD readout panel on right shoulder showing cell integrity status and detonation history; numbered cell positions (1-24) laser-etched in white on each module
distinctive_features: Hexagonal raised cell modules with faint vapor-etched warnings in Arcturus corporate script
Iridescent reactive compound visible through transparent cell caps—material shifts color under angle changes
Scorch marks and blast scorching visible on field-used units around previously activated cells
Kinetic dampening gel layer visible as faint translucent striations between outer housing and cell cartridges
Minimalist AR-compatible hardpoint slots for mounting additional tactical equipment
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS embossed in sans-serif across upper back yoke; small regulatory stamps indicating GLMZ compliance and explosive ordnance certification; serial number engraved on rear mounting plate; Φ price tier indicator (3+) stamped in corner
physical_description.condition_typical: Operators typically wear with visible dust accumulation in crevices. Field-used examples show replacement cell cartridges in various states of installation. Blast residue darkening around edges of previously-detonated modules is common. Webbing develops color fade from UV and sweat exposure.
